caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with ornate detailing. The chair is predominantly dark brown, with decorative gold designs on the top backrest rail and the central splat. The seat is upholstered in a deep red fabric, which has subtle stitched or embossed decorative patterns. The legs of the chair are straight in the front with turned detailing at the top and feet, and the back legs are curved. The armrests are also curved, matching the elegant design of the chair. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a partial, black-and-white pencil sketch showing a detailed view of the chair's backrest design, focusing on the top rail and splat. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, highlighting the chair as the central object. The name "Edna Ray" is written in small cursive in the bottom right corner.
title: Arm Chair
